motions.topic: Close the 6 deep-compute gaps, smallest first, so each is a sound, honest change rather than gibberish: (23) an empty-description card returns a boundary 'empty task description' and moves to REVIEW/DONE without crashing the 30s loop; (24) a census task mode wires op_agent_census (Shield native /ddr/scan, Vision native multimodal-ingestion with a gap, honest tally); (15) comparative docking — the executor threads TWO ligand SMILES against one target structure and returns both dG values labeled, no fudged numbers; (16) per-target DeepDTA — a multi-target title splits into per-target verdicts (in-tree sequence -> pKd path, missing -> targets_without_sequence, pkd null); (17) invalid SMILES — the executor returns a boundary 'invalid SMILES' instead of silently re-using a pre-baked pose; (25) compound chaining — the executor sequences recall -> dock -> journal so one card emits the ChEMBL id, the dG, and a sealed ledger block. Every fix lands in the Rust executor (no Python in the runtime path) and is verified by re-running the failing card against its Pass Criteria. READ FROM SOURCE (25-task campaign): 6 remaining gaps after the yes-man doctrine + auto-journal were already fixed and committed (0ffc41f). (23) a card with an empty description silently recalls on its title instead of returning a boundary. (24) 'verify agent status for Shield and Vision' routes to recall — there is no census task mode, though op_agent_census exists. (15) comparative docking needs the executor to dock TWO ligands against one target (currently one pre-baked pose per task). (16) per-target DeepDTA needs the executor to split a multi-target title (Mpro AND KRAS) into per-target verdicts. (17) an invalid SMILES never reaches the RDKit conformer step because that step is offline — the executor needs a graceful boundary. (25) compound chaining (recall -> dock -> journal) needs the executor to sequence multiple native ops. REJECT AS PREMATURE any change that fakes a multi-target or multi-ligand result with a single hardcoded pose (the whole point is real per-input compute), or that moves RDKit/SMILES handling into the runtime Python path (offline-only).
